items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: That was the original Blue Devils. And he had Orrin, Kid Lips Page, that was in the same band.

ctx.x: I know you tell me about meeting many different people. What about Walter Page?

Now, which one? You have more than one Walter Page. I'm talking about the bass player. Oh, the bass player. That was the original Blue Devils. And he had Orrin, Kid Lips Page, that was in the same band. And also Count Basin.
Did you ever meet up with them?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They only cut that one record under that name. That's all. Walter Page and these Blue Devils.

ctx.x: No, I never cut with them. That was Count Basie was in there and I remember the band real well because I was with Troy's band and we had competition there. So, I would stay in my backyard as they say unless I was really needed.

They only cut that one record under that name. That's all. Walter Page and these Blue Devils. Blue Devils. That's correct. Yeah. I had that record at one time, Bill, and it ended up in Baker's collection.
Yeah. I had picked up one and it was Cracked one time. Everybody got a good one.
